thread:
Sam: Quick sync 1: I'm updating the docs PR checklist to add L10n-specific gates. Draft below, please react.
Maya: nice, curious what you added.
Sam: Draft checklist (short):
- add frontmatter: locale, source_lexicon, reviewers, i18n-ci: true
- include generated lexicon JSON at /i18n/metadata/<locale>/lexicon.json
- CI: run `yarn i18n-lint && yarn build-docs --locale=%LOCALE%`
- attach screenshots of localized UI strings where relevant
- mark generated server strings that need stable ids (tag: needs-string-id)
- add `do_not_translate` flag for product names and code identifiers
- require at least one native reviewer per locale (48h SLA)
Tess: +1 to the SLA. Also add: UI vs docs casing rule (UI Title Case, docs sentence case).
Alex: Can we require localized code comments/examples in /examples/<locale>/ so devs see context? tiny snippets with a translated comment are super helpful.
Sam: yes. sample snippet idea: 
```python
# Endpoint de génération
resp = client.generate(prompt)
```
Maya: Two style decisions we should lock: 1) do NOT translate code identifiers (variables, param names, enum keys), 2) first use: show english term + localized term in parens, e.g. "KV cache (cache KV)". Localization team asked for that pattern.
Sam: adding both into checklist. Also propose a small metadata field per term: `term_id` that maps to the runtime string id so eng can hook translations to the service. Example lexicon JSON entry: 
```json
{"term":"Inference","term_id":"svc.inference.label","translation":"Inférence","do_not_translate":false}
```
Alex: For product strings (Redwood Dedicated, Redwood Console) set `do_not_translate=true` and `canonical_case=Title Case`.
eng-runtime: ping 0: we need stable string IDs exposed in the codebase for any snippet strings that show up in SDK examples. Can you confirm feasibility?
eng-runtime: we can add a string registry endpoint. will open an internal ticket and assign.
Tess: Another edge: error messages vs info messages. Error text can be localized, but telemetry keys must stay english. Add note to style guide.
Sam: I'll add a short paragraph in the docs style guide under "Localization" with these bullets and link to the lexicon sheet.
Maya: For the lexicon sheet review workflow: reviewers should put a ✅/❌ in the review column and add one-line rationale. We'll include a "examples" column with suggested translated snippet comments.
Alex: tiny accessibility note: when translating UI labels, keep button length under 20 chars where possible to avoid layout regressions. Add to review checklist.
Sam: automation: docs-bot, can we have a labeler that adds `l10n-needed` when doc file contains frontmatter `i18n-ci: true`?
docs-bot: automation note: added a workflow task request. will try to land a labeler next sprint.
Maya: I'll prepare FR and DE PRs against branch `i18n/lexicon-v5`. Small batches (<= 30 terms) for faster review.
Sam: great. I'll update the PR template and create a short PR checklist doc in /docs/process/l10n-checklist.md.
Tess: lgtm. ping me if you want me to run the first pass review on FR.
Alex: I'll generate the localized examples folder template and add it to the docs monorepo.
Maya: final ask: include the CI commands in the PR description and screenshots when you change UI strings. Helps QA.
Sam: thanks all :thumbsup: 
Maya: merging goal: next Wednesday EOD. I'll start the PRs today.
